pluginConfigFields.label: AD4Q units on this computer's network are found automatically. For units on another subnet, list their addresses below or add them by IP address.
Additional AD4Q addresses
pluginConfigFields.help: Comma-separated IP addresses to ask directly, for units that multicast does not reach.

pluginConfigFields.label: Refresh interval
pluginConfigFields.help: How often every setting is re-read from the unit. Changes the unit pushes itself arrive at once regardless.

pluginConfigFields.label: Quick toggles
pluginConfigFields.help: One-step switches beside the channel settings: Tone generator on (-30 dB) / off. Turn off to hide them.

pluginConfigFields.label: Simulate an AD4Q
pluginConfigFields.help: Adds a simulated four-channel unit on this computer, for trying the workflow with no hardware. It never talks to a real device.
